text:
Nora: quick proposal to standardize status tokens + mapping_v so dashboards, SDKs, and alerts all align. feedback?
Diego: high level: keep HTTP codes as-is, add `X-Rdwd-Status-Token` and `X-Rdwd-Mapping-V`. that way logs are parseable and UI can pick human copy.
Chen: agree. add `X-Rdwd-Status-Class` too (RETRYABLE|TERMINAL|DEGRADED). SDKs can use class to decide backoff, independent of Retry-After.
Nora: example payload: 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Rdwd-Status-Token: QUOTA_LIMIT
X-Rdwd-Status-Class: TERMINAL
X-Rdwd-Mapping-V: 2024.03
X-Rdwd-Telemetry: token=QUOTA_LIMIT;mapping_v=2024.03;zone=eu-west-1

Priya: telemetry: capture status.token and status.mapping_v as trace/span attributes and log fields. makes correlation in APM trivial.
Diego: console UX: show short message like "Quota exceeded" and an expandable details row that shows token and a link to mapping docs. hide raw token by default.
Nora: rollout plan: shadow headers for 14d, publish mapping API, opt-in SDK flag for token consumption, default-on after 60d, deprecate old verbose headers after 120d.
Chen: compatibility: any token rename -> bump mapping_v and produce overlap window. document no-breaking policy.
ops-bot: can add aggregation rule for X-Rdwd-Status-Token and an alert when count(token=QUOTA_LIMIT) > 1000 in 5m. creating PR.
Priya: test checklist for PR: header present in responses, mapping API returns token, telemetry shows mapping_v, SDK tests simulate pinned mapping_v and latest.
Diego: small UI note: include mapping_v timestamp in the details panel so customers see when copy last changed.
Nora: great, I'll draft the RFC and mapping schema. will tag @Chen @Priya @Diego once ready.
